apps.localizedDescription: A four-room action prototype with katana, dash, lightning, upgrade choices and an original boss. This delivery changes only the app name/version/build in root Info.plist to address AltStore 3009. Native code and all Data are reused unchanged from 0.2.0; the in-game HUD still shows the previous Russian title. No fresh gameplay build or device-install test. Temporary prototype graphics; no real payments or enabled metaprogression saving.

versions.localizedDescription: Plist-only app-name fix for AltStore 3009. Reuses unchanged 0.2 native code and Data; the old Russian in-game HUD title remains until the complete rename. No fresh Xcode/gameplay build. Final package names, CRC, size, SHA-256 and unchanged member bytes/modes checked. Physical iPhone installation is untested.
Первый проверенный игровой фрагмент. 26 Play Mode PASS; iOS-export и Xcode device build прошли. IPA unsigned/re-signable; устройство и установка AltStore не проверены.
